properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] ExpressRoute: Audit Private Peering Only Configuration
properties.description: Audits that ExpressRoute circuits are configured with private peering only and do not have Microsoft peering or public peering enabled. FedRAMP High requires boundary protection (SC-7) to prevent unauthorized traffic flows over public internet paths. Private peering ensures traffic between on-premises and Azure traverses a dedicated, non-internet path.

metadata.description: Audit: Report non-compliance when Microsoft peering or public peering is configured on the circuit. Disabled: Do not evaluate. Note: Deny effect is not used because peering configuration is a sub-resource managed separately from the circuit resource.
